resources.description: Daily OHLCV for Nifty 500 stocks from Jan 2022, auto-updated every weekday. Prices are split- and dividend-adjusted (Yahoo Finance auto_adjust). Sessions Yahoo has not finalised, and market holidays it pads with stale prices, are excluded.
Nifty 500 constituent list with sector and industry labels.
Per-symbol first date, last date and bar count, regenerated on every update. full_history marks symbols with at least 90% of the longest history.
